title: AStages Curios
description: Adds a bridge between AStages and Curios.
body:
## AStages-Curios Addon

This mod provides an integration between **[AStages](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/astages)** and **[Curios](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios)**.  
It allows modpack creators to **lock or unlock Curios equipment slots** based on a player's acquired stages.

### Features

*   Prevent players from equipping Curios unless they have a specific stage.
*   Seamless integration between AStages and Curios.
*   Ideal for progression-based modpacks.

> Requires both AStages and Curios to be installed.

### Customization

See the **[Wiki](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/wiki)** for usage examples and customization options!
